find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(JSONCPP REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET jsoncpp)
pkg_check_modules(ECCODES QUIET IMPORTED_TARGET eccodes)
if(NOT TARGET hardened_original_engine)
  set(ORIGINAL_ROUTING_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  add_subdirectory(../../original-routing-engine original-routing-engine)
endif()
add_library(atlas_benchmark_quick2 STATIC ../../quick2-routing-engine/src/Engine.cpp)
target_include_directories(atlas_benchmark_quick2 PUBLIC ../../quick2-routing-engine/include
  PRIVATE ../../weather-routing-engine/src)
target_link_libraries(atlas_benchmark_quick2 PUBLIC weather_routing_engine)
add_executable(atlas_benchmark Benchmark.cpp)
target_link_libraries(atlas_benchmark PRIVATE atlas_routing_engine atlas_benchmark_quick2
  hardened_original_engine quick_weather_routing_engine alternative_weather_routing_engine PkgConfig::JSONCPP)
if(ECCODES_FOUND)
  target_link_libraries(atlas_benchmark PRIVATE PkgConfig::ECCODES)
  target_compile_definitions(atlas_benchmark PRIVATE ATLAS_HAS_ECCODES=1)
endif()
add_executable(atlas_contracts Contracts.cpp)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(atlas_contracts PRIVATE atlas_routing_engine PkgConfig::JSONCPP Threads::Threads)
foreach(group math preflight resources waiting weather coastal propulsion observers concurrency providers guidance)
  add_test(NAME atlas-${group} COMMAND atlas_contracts ${group})
  set_tests_properties(atlas-${group} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 90)
endforeach()
